Today’s episode continues with Alokenath Tripathi’s attempt to get rid of bottle gourd from his tiffin box. His wife, Mrs. Tripathi keeps preparing bottle gourd centric dishes and soups for her husband. Frustrated with Bottle Gourd, Mr. Tripathi chooses to exchange his tiffin box secretly with his colleagues! Want to know what happened next? Then stay tuned in and find out here!
